description: Identifies the application-specific component scope used by wireframe registries. Scoped custom component types are namespaced as app:{appId}:{localType}.

members.name: AppId
members.description: Application id for this component scope.

members.name: TypePrefix
members.description: Type prefix used for custom components in this scope.

members.name: ForApp
members.description: Creates a component scope for the supplied application id.

members.name: ForApp
members.description: Creates a component scope for the supplied application id.

members.name: FromAppId
members.description: Creates a scope when an application id is present; otherwise returns null.

members.name: IsScopedType
members.description: Returns true when type is an app-scoped component type.

members.name: TryGetAppId
members.description: Attempts to extract the application id from an app-scoped component type.

members.name: GetLocalType
members.description: Returns the local component type name without the app scope prefix.

members.name: NamespaceType
members.description: Returns the scoped type for a local component type.

members.name: MatchesAppId
members.description: Returns true when appId identifies the same scope.

members.name: ContainsType
members.description: Returns true when type belongs to this app scope.

members.name: AppPackId
members.description: Returns the target pack id for an app-scoped pack.

members.name: IsVisibleInTargetPacks
members.description: Returns true when a schema/definition is visible for the supplied document target packs. Null or empty target lists preserve legacy visibility; built-ins are always visible.
